info.title: Call Analyzer API
info.description:
API for processing call center audio recordings. Handles audio upload,
transcription (via ElevenLabs), CDR integration with VoiceSpin,
AI-powered translation/Q&A, and role-based access control.

## Authentication

**Internal API** (`/api/v1/*`): Uses JWT Bearer tokens obtained via the auth callback flow.

**External API** (`/api/external/*`): Uses a static API token passed in the `X-API-Token` header.

**Sync API** (`/api/v1/sync/*`): Uses service-to-service authentication via `X-Service-Token` header.
